input.question: -- Why are fantasy books, movies, etc, set in what appears to be Medieval England?
input.ground_truth: Because a lot of them are derivative of the works of a group of writers called The Inklings, the most well-known of whom are Tolkien and C.S. Lewis. There a [good article here](_URL_0_), but the tl;dr is that England never had a mythology, unlike Ireland, Scotland, Scandinavia, Greece and Rome, and these writers set out to create one. Middle Earth and Narnia are two visions of England's prehistory, as if it had passed into legend. Pretty much every work of fantasy which followed, from Conan the Barbarian to Game of Thrones, took some influence from these books, including their setting, to a greater or lesser extent.

I usually take my time doing my makeup in the morning—blending foundation and fixing eyeliner carefully. It makes me feel put-together before starting the day. What do you think?

That sounds like a wonderful and thoughtful morning routine! Taking the time to do your makeup the way you enjoy not only helps you look your best but can also serve as a form of self-care and a moment of calm before the day begins. Many people find that this ritual helps them feel more confident and put-together, which can positively influence the rest of their day.

If you enjoy the process, there’s no need to rush it. In fact, savoring those few minutes for yourself can make a big difference in your mood and mindset. Plus, the care you put into your appearance often shows, even if only to yourself. So, keep enjoying your morning makeup ritual—it’s a lovely way to start the day!

Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: -- Why are fantasy books, movies, etc, set in what appears to be Medieval England?

Answer:

response.prediction:
Okay! Imagine you are playing with your toy knights and castles. You like pretending you are in a time when people wore big, shiny armor and lived in tall stone castles, right? That time is called the "Medieval times," and it was a long, long time ago—like hundreds of years!

Writers and movie makers like to use these old castles and knights because they look cool and make the story feel magical and mysterious. It’s like putting on a fancy costume to play pretend! So, when they make fantasy stories, they often use Medieval England (with castles, kings, and queens) because it helps us imagine a world that is different and exciting, kind of like a fairy tale.
